Players score points during a round by winning tricks containing specific cards and at the end of a round based on the number of total tricks they won. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Overview 2 Gameplay 3 Card Rules Clarificiations 4 Witch 5 Swans 6 Variants Overview Be the first to reach 21 points through taking or not taking tricks (according to the point distribution). Each round consists of 13 tricks. Gameplay At the beginning of a turn, a player plays a card. The second player must play a card of the same suit. If they cannot, they are free to play any card. The card that matches the suit of the Decree (trump) card wins. If both cards are of the same suit, the card with the higher rank wins. If no one has yet scored 21 or more points, a new round begins with a new Decree card. Cards with odd-numbered ranks have special abilities that can affect who wins the trick or a player's hand. This is displayed in the gameplay area. Scoring is related to the number of tricks taken. Take note that taking all the tricks is not the goal of the game. The most points are scored from taking none/few tricks or most but not all tricks. Card Rules Clarificiations A card's ability is executed when the card is played and before either the follower's card is played or the winner of the trick is determined. This means that if someone leads with a 3 (Fox) of Keys and switches out the Decree card to be the Moon suit, they can potentially lose the trick if the follower plays a Moon card. Witch The 9 (Witch) 's suit does not change until both cards have been played, and whether both cards are 9 (Witch) . If two 9 (Witch) s were played, the Witch's suit doesn't change. If one card is of the trump suit, it wins. If neither card is of the trump suit, the leader's card is the winner (since the follower didn't follow). In the same vein, a player cannot follow a trump card with a non-trump 9 (Witch) , since the Witch doesn't change suits until both cards are played. Swans If two 1 (Swan) s are played, the card of the trump suit wins. If neither card is of the trump suit, the leader's card is the winner (since the follower didn't follow). In either case, the player who did not win the trick would lead the next trick. Variants For a shorter game, the goal can be set to 16 points. For a longer game, the goal can be set to 35 points. [Rating: 1/10] Forgettable two player trick taking game. There's the nice drawback off winning too much. However, the game still benefits the better drawn hand too much.

[Rating: 1/10] Worst Trick taking game I have played. I would rather play Hearts or Spades or "Oh Hell" with a standard deck of cards.

[Rating: 1/10] I'm sick of half the cards in the deck having a special power attached. Seriously, it's a goddamn trend among euro tricktakers, and I feel so bored every time I see it again (it probably originated here, so thanks a lot). Plus there's the ridiculously convoluted scoring chart. It's like the game doesn't trust players to control it, so the game has to pilot THEM.

[Rating: 2/10] Ranking: :star::nostar::nostar::nostar::nostar:  A good two player trick-taking game.  Update: Played it again and neither me or my girlfriend enjoyed it. On the sell pile.

[Rating: 2/10] Found it too boring. It is simple trick playing mechanism nothing very exiciting, more luck of draw and abilities do not match the characters.

[Rating: 2/10] 2020 You can play this game with a normal deck of cards. While the box has beautiful art and some of the cards have ok art at the front they are of bad quality and the back of the cards is just ugly. I was super hyped about this 2 player game but I can only say that I don't recommend anyone buying it. Plus the tricks can be unbalanced. Overall is fun to play like you play "sueca" but the quality of the edition makes me feel that this game is not worth the amount of money its costs when new.

[Rating: 2/10] A bit like Red7 with a bit of Dixit point ruling thrown in. Prefer playing Red7 or Dixit to this one. The artwork is kind of weird.

[Rating: 2/10] This really fell flat for us. Nothing exciting and I kept waiting for it to get fun.
